body.name: Exact nice-decomposition recurrence
body.construction: At an empty leaf initialize \(\varnothing,\varnothing,\mathbf 0_K\) with value zero. At an introduce-vertex node, assign a label with \(c_k=0\) and create its singleton block. At an introduce-edge node for \(e\in E\), merge the two endpoint blocks exactly when their labels agree; for \(e\in E_F\setminus E\), leave the connectivity partition unchanged. At a forget node, delete the vertex from its block; if its whole block disappears while another block of the same label remains, reject, and if it was the last active block set \(c_k=1\). At a join, require the same bag labeling, merge child partitions by transitive closure, require \(c_k=0\) in both children for every label active in the bag, and for an absent label reject \(c_k=1\) in both children while otherwise taking the logical disjunction. Add exactly the local costs indexed by \(H_t\). At the empty root accept exactly \((\varnothing,\varnothing,\mathbf1_K)\).
